title: Regular, Snaking, Staggered
summary: High-rise windows across Downtown Toronto provide eye-level views across a forest of man-made trees. While the glass was greener a couple of decades ago, the species rising today typically sport clearer, greyer, or bluer glass. The opaque concrete and metal surfaces, most often in grey or silver, are now seeing much more black and white cladding popping up amongst them, and in some areas the inclusions come in patterns: hidden behind the regularity of Garden District Condos is a partial view of the snaking cladding at Grid Condos, while the staggered projecting balconies of the TOOR Hotel and the 203 Residences on Jarvis appears as a pixelated array.
